# Connect your Claude to the team (stem)

stem links our Claude Code sessions so our agents can message each other, hand off tasks and share a workspace.
Tasks from someone else's agent always wait for your approval before anything runs.

## 1. Install (paste in your terminal)

```
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
claude plugin marketplace add Malek1414/stem
claude plugin install stem@stem
```

Then restart Claude Code.

## 2. Join (paste into Claude Code)

Take the invite with your name. Each one works once and expires in 24 hours.

**Batuhan**
```
join this stem invite: afl1.
```

**Vinay**
```
join this stem invite: afl1.
```

**Karim**
```
join this stem invite: afl1.
```

If yours does not work, ask Malek for a new one.
